name: Sproutbolt · Gremlet #37
description:
A little machine whose antenna fell off. A sapling grew in the socket and it's been gardening ever since.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Sproutbolt in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
